name: Scientific feature
about: Propose a new quantum-chemistry method, property, or scientific capability
title: "Science: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Scientific Motivation

What scientific use case or limitation would this capability address?

## Proposed Capability and Initial Scope

Describe the desired method, property, or algorithm. Clearly separate the
minimum useful implementation from possible later extensions.

## Theory and References

Provide relevant equations, publications, or authoritative references.

## Approximations and Conventions

State assumptions involving units, normalization, spin, references, frozen
orbitals, integral ordering, or energy definitions.

## Inputs and Results

Describe the required inputs and observable results. Include a possible CLI or
runfile interface when useful, without treating it as a fixed design.

## Interaction With Existing Methods

Explain how this capability relates to the existing basis, integral, RHF, UHF,
or MP2 paths.

## Validation Strategy

Identify trusted implementations, representative systems, expected values, and
appropriate tolerances.

## Computational Constraints

Note expected scaling, memory requirements, numerical risks, or known limits.

## Acceptance Criteria

What must be implemented, tested, and documented for this issue to be complete?

## Out of Scope

Which related capabilities should explicitly be deferred?

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched the existing issues and roadmap for related proposals.
- [ ] I included enough scientific context to evaluate the proposal.
